subcategory: Male Compression X Male Nptf Adapter
pressure: Up To 600 Psi; Up To 41 Bar
description: Male Compression X Male Nptf Adapter, A Connector Combining A Male Compression End With A Male Nptf Threaded End. Precision‑Machined For Secure Joining, It Ensures Consistent Sealing Performance. Built With Durable Material For Long‑Term Reliability In Threaded Systems.

Apply Sealant To Male Nptf End.

Cut Tube Squarely.
Slide Nut And Sleeve On Tube.

Hand-Tighten , Then Wrench-Tighten 1 To 1 1/2 Turn For Compression And 1 To 2 Turns For Nptf End.
Test For Leaks.
